name: Yondu

abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Stifle: Saldırı Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Special Concussion: Etkilenen şampiyonların özel saldırı sırasındaki yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.

howToPlay: Yondu için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Tech sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Centaurian Archery
Yondu's high-octave vocal range gives him precise control over his yaka arrows. Enemies activating a Special Attack suffer Weakness for each Debuff effect they're suffering from at the time of the activation, reducing Attack by [15 - 40]% for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: For each Debuff on the Opponent, they suffer -10% Combat Power Rate. Max: -50%.
Yondu's Fin stabilizes his head, granting Immunity to incoming Concussion Debuffs when fighting against Mutant Champions.

abilitySections.title: Yaka Arrow
content: Yondu's Yaka Arrow attacks are non-contact, have +[916.67] Armor and Block Penetration, as well as the following:
100% chance to inflict a Rupture Debuff dealing [12,085.2] Physical Damage over 7 seconds. Max stacks: 5. If the Opponent has 4 or more unique Buffs, this potency is reduced by half.
If these Ruptures are prevented by Immunity, inflict a [485.29 ] Armor Break Debuff for 9 seconds.
The strength and precision of Yondu's Yaka Arrow allows it to trigger Critical Hits and personal Abilities through the Opponent's Block.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks - Through Block
content: 35% chance to Pilfer 1 Armor Up Buff.
For each Armor Up Pilfered or Prowess Invalidated, gain an Armor Up Buff, granting +[1,833.33] Armor Rating for 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict a non-stacking 60% Stifle Debuff for 10 seconds.
The final hit inflicts a Heal Block Debuff for 20 seconds. If the Opponent has a Regeneration effect, instead inflict a 30 second Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a +[4,531.95] Fury Passive for 24 seconds. Yondu gains an extra Fury for each Special Attack the Opponent has used since the fight started. Max stacks: 8.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to gain a +[916.67] Precision Buff for 20 seconds.
100% chance to inflict an indefinite, non-stacking Passive Special Concussion, reducing Ability Accuracy during Special Attacks by 100% until the end of the opponent's next Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Centaurian Archery
content: Yondu's high-octave vocal range gives him precise control over his yaka arrows. Enemies activating a Special Attack suffer Weakness for each Debuff effect they're suffering from at the time of the activation, reducing Attack by [15 - 40]% for 5 seconds.
